question: Who is appointed as the new managing director of LIC in January, 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siddhartha Mohanty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Siddhartha Mohanty was appointed as the new managing director of LIC in January 2021.
 
• He took over from T.C. Suseel Kumar who retired from the position.
 
• Siddhartha Mohanty has been with LIC for over three decades, holding various important positions.
 
• Prior to being appointed as Managing Director, he served as the Chief Executive Officer of LIC Housing Finance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)**

 
 
• LIC is an Indian state-owned insurance group and investment corporation.
 
• It was founded in 1956 when the Parliament of India passed the Life Insurance of India Act that nationalized the insurance industry in India.
 
• Over the years, LIC has grown to become the largest insurance company in India.
 
• LIC offers a wide range of insurance products and services to cater to various needs of its customers.
 
 
 
• **LIC Housing Finance**
 
 
• LIC Housing Finance is one of the largest Housing Finance companies in India.
 
• It was incorporated on June 19, 1989, under the Companies Act, 1956.
 
• The company provides long-term finance to individuals for the purchase or construction of houses or flats for residential purposes.
 
• LIC Housing Finance also provides finance on existing property for business or personal needs and gives loans to professionals for the purchase or construction of clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centers, office space, etc.
 
 
 
• **Roles and Responsibilities of a Managing Director**
 
 
• The Managing Director (MD) is responsible for the overall performance of the company.
